extracted.intended_audience: companies, financial institutions, investors (asset managers/owners), and other stakeholders preparing or assessing climate-related financial disclosures
extracted.subtask_description: Collection of TCFD publications and guidance to help companies and financial-sector actors implement the Task Force’s recommendations for climate-related financial disclosure, including governance, strategy, risk management, metrics/targets, scenario analysis and sector-specific guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: TCFD recommendations (overview)
rubrics_metrics.description: The first workshop presentation provides an introduction to the TCFD and an overview of the four TCFD recommendations for climate-related financial disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The remaining four workshop presentations provide more details on each of the TCFD recommendations, including example disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Governance (TCFD recommendation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Governance is one of the four TCFD recommendations covered in the TCFD workshops and materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 'Governance Workshop' presentation for details and example disclosures on how governance of climate-related risks and opportunities should be described.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategy (TCFD recommendation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategy is one of the four TCFD recommendations covered in the TCFD workshops and materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 'Strategy Workshop' presentation for details and example disclosures on how strategy and the resilience of strategy to climate-related issues should be disclosed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk Management (TCFD recommendation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Risk Management is one of the four TCFD recommendations covered in the TCFD workshops and materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 'Risk Management Workshop' presentation for details and example disclosures on integrating and disclosing climate-related risk management processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metrics and Targets (TCFD recommendation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Metrics and Targets is one of the four TCFD recommendations covered in the TCFD workshops and materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 'Metrics and Targets Workshop' presentation for details and example disclosures on selecting and reporting climate-related metrics and targets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance on Metrics, Targets, and Transition Plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Dedicated guidance document titled 'Guidance on Metrics, Targets, and Transition Plans'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides guidance to help companies and investors develop, select and report metrics, targets, and transition plans; available in multiple languages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementing the Recommendations of the TCFD (general implementation guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Implementing guidance that explains how organizations should put the TCFD recommendations into practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes general and sector-specific guidance (see Annex) and has been updated (2017 Annex superseded by 2021 Annex).

rubrics_metrics.name: Annex: Implementing the Recommendations (sector-specific guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: The 2017 TCFD 'Annex' provides both general and sector-specific guidance on implementing the Task Force’s disclosure recommendations; the 2017 version has been superseded by the 2021 Annex.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Annex for sector-specific considerations when preparing disclosures aligned with TCFD recommendations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance on Scenario Analysis for Non-Financial Companies
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical guidance intended to assist non-financial companies interested in using climate-related scenarios as part of their efforts to implement the Task Force’s recommendations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides practical, process-oriented ways for companies to use climate-related scenario analysis and ideas for disclosing the resilience of their strategies to different climate-related scenarios.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance on Risk Management Integration and Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance aimed at companies interested in integrating climate-related risks into their existing risk management processes and disclosing information on those processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aimed at helping organizations align their risk management processes and accompanying disclosures with the TCFD recommendations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical Supplement: The Use of Scenario Analysis in Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: The Technical Supplement advises companies on conducting climate-related scenario analysis, a fundamental TCFD recommendation that helps companies plan for resilience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides technical detail and methods to support scenario analysis used in disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workshops in a Box / Training and example disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: A set of five presentations for use in introductory workshops on the TCFD recommendations to help support adoption and implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes an introductory TCFD presentation and four workshops that each provide more details on one recommendation, including example disclosures—intended as training materials to support implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: TCFD Status Reports (monitoring progress and challenges)
rubrics_metrics.description: Periodic Status Reports (e.g., 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020) that describe companies’ progress in making climate-related financial disclosures and highlight challenges they face.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status Reports describe insights gained over time and areas warranting continued focus or further work by others; used to assess adoption and effectiveness of disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public consultations and summaries on metrics and forward-looking financial sector metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Documents summarizing responses to public consultations (e.g., on Proposed Guidance on Climate-related Metrics, Targets, and Transition Plans; Measuring Portfolio Alignment; Forward-Looking Financial Sector Metrics).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summaries capture stakeholder feedback on usefulness and challenges, informing refinement of guidance and metric selection for reporting and policy.
